Question: An 1800-g (4.0-lb) male newborn is delivered to a 26-year-old woman, gravida 2, para 1, at 33 weeks' gestation. The Apgar scores are 7 at 1 minute and 8 at 5 minutes. It is most appropriate for the physician to recommend which of the following to the mother regarding her son's immunizations?

opb. Give first dose of influenza vaccine at 2 months of chronological age
opc. Give first dose of varicella vaccine at 2 months of chronological age
opd. Give first dose of Haemophilus influenza type b vaccine at 3 months of chronological age
ope. Give first dose of diphtheria and tetanus toxoids, acellular pertussis (DTaP) vaccine at 2 months of chronological age
